stem: A blocked powered component can only be cleared by removing a guard. The operator SOP does not authorize guard removal. What should the technician do?
choices: Remove the guard because the blockage is visible.
Hold the stop button while reaching in.
Ask another technician to remove the guard.
Stop at the operator-care boundary and route the work through the authorized servicing process.
rationale: Stop at the operator-care boundary and route the work through the authorized servicing process. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
